name: Full SEO audit of a URL
prompt: Run an SEO audit on our pricing page.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for product and region context
Fetches the live page HTML rather than auditing from memory
Benchmarks against a top-ranking competitor for the primary keyword
Presents the biggest issues, then asks about primary keyword, region, and GSC access
Returns a prioritized table (CRITICAL/WARNING/OPTIMIZATION) with evidence, impact, and fix
Ends with Quick Wins, Competitive Gap, and a 30-day roadmap

name: Diagnose a non-ranking page
prompt: Why isn't this blog post ranking?
expected_behavior: Checks indexability signals (canonical, robots, status codes)
Compares content depth and entities against the ranking set
Flags intent mismatch if the page targets the wrong intent
Gives a ranked set of fixes tied to the ranking gap

name: Core Web Vitals and performance
prompt: Check the technical performance of our homepage.
expected_behavior: Inspects render-blocking resources, image optimization, and layout-shift risks
Reports only observed/fetched signals and flags what it could not measure

name: AI-search readiness within the audit
prompt: Is this page ready for Google AI Overviews?
expected_behavior: Checks for a direct-answer block in the first 100 words
Checks structured data and entity clarity
Recommends aeo-content-optimizer / schema-markup-generator for deeper work
